morphology.pattern_note: 作为英语专名整词记忆，不套用马来语词缀规则；英语内部由 black（黑色）与 beard（胡须）组成。所列音标为英式英语读音。

senses.zh_definition: 黑胡子：十八世纪海盗爱德华·蒂奇的绰号；属于人物专名。
senses.en_definition: The nickname of Edward Teach, an eighteenth-century pirate.
senses.ms_definition: Nama julukan Edward Teach, seorang lanun yang terkenal pada awal abad kelapan belas.
senses.nuances: 通常写作 Blackbeard，首字母大写；此处按历史人物释义，具体作品中的同名角色须结合语境判断。它不是马来语中泛指黑胡须的普通名词；普通名词应说 janggut hitam。输入未提供 DBP 释义、音节或 Jawi，缺项保留 null；status 按指定格式填写，不表示该专名获得 DBP 词条认证。人物依据：[Smithsonian 人物介绍](https://americanhistory.si.edu/explore/exhibitions/on-the-water/online/living-atlantic-world/pirates/edward-teach-blackbeard)。

etymology.historical_story: Blackbeard is an English nickname built from black and beard. Edward Teach's conspicuous dark beard supplied the name, while accounts of smoking fuses before battle helped establish his intimidating image. His story belongs to Atlantic maritime history; the name should therefore be learned as a historical proper noun rather than a Malay descriptive word. [Smithsonian account](https://americanhistory.si.edu/explore/exhibitions/on-the-water/online/living-atlantic-world/pirates/edward-teach-blackbeard).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: black＝黑，beard＝胡须；把两个英语词拼成一张海盗的脸，就是 Blackbeard“黑胡子”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈历史人物时属于中性专名；给现实中的人起“黑胡子”绰号前，应考虑对方是否接受。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于历史、博物馆及作品讨论。正式马来语文字保留 Blackbeard 的大写，不用它泛指有黑胡须的人。
